label: Webflow
description: Manage Webflow CMS collections, items, and e-commerce orders over the REST API.
notes: Piece source targets Webflow's legacy v1 API (no version prefix), which Webflow has sunset; nodes were upgraded to the current v2 endpoints (/v2/...) and v2 response paths using vendor API knowledge. Simplifications: find-collection-item's client-side field filtering cannot be templated, so it is exposed as listCollectionItems (fetch items, filter downstream); its optional limit/offset query params were dropped because empty query values are not tolerated (API defaults apply). fulfill-order's optional boolean sendOrderFulfilledEmail was dropped per typed-JSON rules (emails are not sent; body is {}). refund-order and unfulfill-order are transpilable single POSTs but were left out under the 8-action cap in favor of more generally useful CMS operations.
